The product image on the box shows a black unit with a digital keypad.

risks.proof: Photo of the actual unit out of the box showing the serial/model plate.
risks.if_unproven: as the model shown on the box

risks.risk: The microwave may have internal damage or fail to heat.

Photo of the manufacturer's label/plate on the rear of the unit.

response.reason: The model H20MOBS6 is clearly legible on the retail packaging in photo 0. While the seller's description has inaccuracies regarding the model and control type, the photographic evidence of the box is sufficient to identify and price the item at its worst-case functional state.
